items.title: Five equivalent descriptions of the spectral subsets of a spectral space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives five equivalent descriptions of the subsets of a spectral space which are themselves spectral via the induced topology, together with statements that such a subset is a limit of the quasi-compact opens containing it (author lemma at source lines 5221-5241, label lemma-make-spectral-space). The proof (source lines 5243-5283) runs the implications, using the constructible topology for the first, the separation of a point from a quasi-compact subset for the middle steps and the cofiltered limit description for the final assertions (proof lines 5243-5282). The separation step and the limit description are the substance. H3.
